title: Determinants of Intention to Use E-commerce in Saudi Arabia
core_idea: Investigate which individual and social factors (e.g., attitude, subjective norms, self-efficacy, trust) influence individuals' intention to use e-commerce in Saudi Arabia using a quantitative survey (281 respondents, convenience sampling) and structural equation modeling (SmartPLS).
tldr: A quantitative study examining how psychological and social factors relate to the intention to adopt e-commerce among residents of Saudi Arabia, using survey data and SEM to inform stakeholders.
